description: Guest Mode - Remove hard login wall, allow users to browse and generate plans without an account. Prompt for login only when accessing save, bucket list, expenses, or AI copilot features.
steps: 1. Create src/utils/authGate.ts with requireAuth(user, onShowAuthModal, feature) function that returns false and shows toast if user is null, true otherwise.

2. Modify src/App.tsx to remove the hard auth wall at lines 520-570. Allow rendering of HeroSection, DestinationShowcase, and TripPlanner even when user is null. Move auth modal to conditional rendering triggered by state.

3. Update src/components/TripPlanner.tsx to wrap handleSaveTrip, handleAddToBucketList, expense tracking button click, and copilot open button with requireAuth checks. If auth is required, show toast and trigger auth modal via callback prop.
4. Add showAuthModal state to src/contexts/AuthContext.tsx and expose it via context so components can trigger the modal programmatically.
5. Implement guest trip storage in localStorage with key pattern 'guest_itinerary_{timestamp}'. When a guest generates a trip, store it locally. Add UI hint showing 'Sign in to save permanently'.
6. Add migration path: when user logs in, check localStorage for guest trips and offer to import them via a modal. After import, clear localStorage guest data.
7. Update src/components/Header.tsx to show 'Sign In' button when user is null instead of blocking the page.
8. Add visual badges/hints on gated features (Save, Bucket List, Expenses, Copilot buttons) showing 'Sign in required' tooltip or icon for guest users.
acceptance_criteria: Guest can visit home page and browse destinations without seeing auth modal
Guest can search destinations and generate trip plans
Guest sees 'Sign in to save trips' toast when clicking Save/Bucket/Expenses/Copilot
Auth modal appears only when guest tries gated features
Logged-in users experience no regression - all features work as before
Guest-generated trip persists in localStorage until login or manual clear
After login, guest can import their unsaved trips from localStorage
All existing tests pass (npm run test)
verification: npm run lint - TypeScript strict mode passes
npm run test - all tests pass
Manual: Open app in incognito, verify home page loads without auth prompt
Manual: Generate a trip as guest, verify localStorage contains trip data
Manual: Click Save button as guest, verify toast appears and auth modal opens
Manual: Sign in after being guest, verify migration offer appears if guest trips exist
